dataset: CO2 and Greenhouse Gas Emissions dataset
underlying_source: Global Carbon Budget (2025); Population based on various sources (2024)
unit: tonnes CO2 per person per year
accounting: Consumption-based; fossil fuels and industry; excludes land-use change and non-CO2 greenhouse gases
international_bunkers: International aviation and shipping not allocated to individual countries, per GCB metadata
country_selection: Australia plus US, UK and Japan as high-income contexts; China and India as contrasting consumption contexts. Illustrative selection, not a world ranking.

personal_reference.scope: Provisional private spending-driven footprint; not equivalent to national final-demand per capita.

comparability: Contextual comparison only. Do not calculate a percentage below national average, infer a like-for-like rank or reinterpret CO2-only references as CO2-e. Matching IO model year does not resolve spending price-year or coverage differences.
